description: (0.5.0) Several issuer pins (RFC-ACDP-0020 §6.2 step 4). Behavioral, consumer-side.

input.golden: trust-001 vector 1 (tenant-acme.production, serial 7, issuer = the sig-003 did:key)

expected.behavior: Pin 1 (golden) does not list sandbox.example.net; pin 2 (a consortium list) does: a body from sandbox.example.net is trusted, attributed to pin 2.
Pin 2 trusts registry.example.com only for type 'alert'; a pin-1-trusted analysis body from it stays trusted.
Pin 1 gives out_of_scope and pin 2 gives expired: the outcome is expired.
Both pins trust the body: the deciding pin is the lower (issuer, list_id) by code point.

scenarios.name: E — a broken pin does not poison

expected.behavior: Pin 2 has no valid version (list_invalid); pin 1 trusts the body: trusted.
A body of type acdp:trust-list from an unpinned issuer, carried in the bundle and listing more registries, is ignored; it is an ordinary body and confers no trust.
